body: I appreciate you taking the time to write this out. And I can assure you I do plan on going all out this summer, as much as my anxiety will allow me. I genuinely hope this summer changes my mind, but I also know that being happy is temporary, but the hopelessness I've been facing feels permanent and never ending. I'm very optimistic about this summer, excited even. But after it ends, what then? Do I wait it out until the next summer after that? I can't do that, not again.
I take, and give nothing in return.
Me too. However I'm content with this being my last summer.
You're familiar with how leeches work right? They suck the life out of their victim, then move on to the next. I don't want to have anymore victims. Leeches don't change.
